description: Replace the webhook subscriptions, as an app would set them up in the vendor's developer settings. Each: { vendor: quickbooks | jobber | housecallpro, url, topics, clientId, clientSecret (signs deliveries: for Jobber the app's OAuth client secret, for QuickBooks its verifier token, for Housecall Pro its signing secret) }. quickbooks topics: qbo.customer.created.v1, qbo.customer.updated.v1, qbo.invoice.created.v1, qbo.invoice.updated.v1, qbo.payment.created.v1. jobber topics: CLIENT_CREATE, INVOICE_UPDATE. housecallpro topics: customer.created, customer.updated, job.created, job.scheduled, job.completed, job.paid, invoice.created, invoice.sent, invoice.payment.succeeded, invoice.paid. Answers as twin_webhooks does.

subscriptions.description: Every subscription to keep, shaped as above; [] removes them all
